revenue_growth.direct_quote: We expect total company revenue to grow low to mid single digits year-over-year.

margin_outlook.direct_quote: Gross margin is guided between 45.5% and 46.5% supported by Services mix.

capex_plans.direct_quote: Capital expenditures are planned in line with historical levels targeting private cloud compute.

demand_outlook.direct_quote: iPhone installed base reached all-time highs with steady replacement cycles in mature markets.

earnings_guidance.direct_quote: Diluted earnings per share anticipated to outpace revenue growth supported by share repurchases.

innovation_pipeline.direct_quote: Rolling rollout of Apple Intelligence features across iPhone, iPad, and Mac platforms.

competitive_position.direct_quote: High customer retention, brand loyalty, and growing ecosystem active installed base.

key_risks: European regulatory scrutiny under DMA compliance
summary: Apple forecasts modest revenue expansion underpinned by record Services performance and Apple Intelligence adoption cycles.
